title: 🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 26 - Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy for Foreign Policy and International Security of the Supreme National Security Council made remark on the  joint meeting of Iran hosting Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye.
text:
🔆🔅TEHRAN, October 26 - Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy for Foreign Policy and International Security of the Supreme National Security Council made remark on the  joint meeting of Iran hosting Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, and Turkiye."

""
"SOT1, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:27): “Today’s four-party meeting in Tehran can effectively be described as a fruit of the heroic resistance of the Iranian people and the victorious valor of the Armed Forces of the Islamic Republic of Iran. It led these countries to a common conclusion, even though their priorities and approaches may differ significantly.”"

"SOT2, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-(00:28 - 00:46): “The Tehran session in fact conveyed a message: even if we have differences and disagreements, through dialogue we can reach a point where we embark on a path that produces solutions for us and can even become a source of cooperation.”"

"SOT3, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-(00:47 - 01:09): “The fundamental discussion held today,which in fact centered on several discussions concerning the fortification of security, is a crucial foundational issue. If we can truly establish sustainable security, it can serve as the basis for development and progress. However, if security is not sustainable, development will not actually take shape; and even if development does occur, it will not be sustainable.”"

"SOT4, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-(01:10 - 01:53): “For years, the Islamic Republic of Iran has emphasized this point: Neighboring countries, brothers! if we truly want to live in a secure region characterized by prosperity and progress, we must engage in synergistic interaction. It is not possible for one country in the region to have security while another does not; security is an interconnected principle. Therefore, when external countries intervene, since they fundamentally seek to secure their own interests, it is not necessarily the case that securing Country A will also secure Country B. Sometimes they enter the region specifically to jeopardize the security of Country B.”"

"SOT5, Ali Bagheri Kani, Deputy Secretary for the Supreme National Security Council of Iran (Farsi)-( 01:54 - 02:38): “Another noteworthy point for me at the Tehran meeting was that all four parties were motivated by the intention of being able to create a path for cooperation. That is, it was not a case in which one country insisted on its own perspective and wanted the others eventually to be dragged along that path. Rather, it was about creating a framework, a framework that could attract the cooperation of these four countries as a core and as an origin for other countries in the region, so that they too would participate in the process of security-making in the region.”
